chunks: Will he find the way who grovels flat on his face, or he who walks straight on the right path?

key_terms.صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ: a straight path, symbolizing correct guidance and righteousness
key_terms.مُكِبًّا: hunched or bent over, often indicating humility or disgrace

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the person who walks on his face and the one who walks straight in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a metaphor for the spiritual state of the disbelievers, whose hearts are sealed, causing them to stumble blindly in the darkness of misguidance. It contrasts their deformed posture with the upright, dignified walk of those who possess 'Aql (intellect) and follow the straight path of the Ahl al-Bayt. This imagery underscores the physical manifestation of inner spiritual blindness versus clarity.
